title: The General Matrix opened from Uncategorized shows that breadcrumb
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Open Settings › Categories.
  2. Click Uncategorized.
  3. Click General Matrix on Uncategorized's page.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Uncategorized is listed.

Step 2:

  • Uncategorized's page opens.

Step 3:

  • The General Matrix page opens.
  • The breadcrumb reads Settings › Categories › Uncategorized › General Matrix.
